integrity: The proof is symbolic. The recent source, the directly relevant four-factor pages of Erdős--Graham, and the closest perfect-power and three-factor literature were materially inspected. No independent audit has been performed.
limitations: The theorem classifies only four-factor square identities valid for every sufficiently large integer parameter. It does not classify isolated solutions, thin subsequences, five-or-more-factor affine families, or higher powers, and it gives no effective threshold for the prime-number-theorem separation step.
title: Classification of four-factor affine square families
